QueryFeedbackRequest.description: The request payload used to filter, sort, and paginate feedback for a DataAgent. All properties are optional; omitted criteria do not constrain the results. Unknown JSON properties in this object or its filter object return `InvalidInput`; unrecognized query parameters are ignored.

search.description: An optional free-text search term with a maximum length of 200 characters. Control characters, including newlines and tabs, return `InvalidInput`. The provider searches the feedback comment, feedback ID, submitter email, and submitter user ID. Matching, tokenization, and case behavior are provider-defined.

startSubmittedDateTime.description: The inclusive lower bound for the feedback submission time. Provide an RFC 3339 timestamp with `Z` or a numeric UTC offset, for example, `2026-07-01T00:00:00-04:00`.

endSubmittedDateTime.description: The inclusive upper bound for the feedback submission time. Provide an RFC 3339 timestamp with `Z` or a numeric UTC offset, for example, `2026-08-01T00:00:00Z`.

filter.description: The typed allowlist of filters applied to the feedback query.

sortBy.description: The property used to sort the feedback.

sortOrder.description: The sort order applied to the feedback. If not specified, the default is `Descending`.

FeedbackFilter.description: A typed allowlist of feedback filters. Values within a single property are combined with a logical OR, and different properties are combined with a logical AND. Unknown properties and control characters in filter values return `InvalidInput`.

channels.description: The feedback channels to include. A maximum of 100 values is accepted. Each value must contain at least one non-whitespace character, be no longer than 256 characters, and contain no control characters such as newlines or tabs. Invalid values return `InvalidInput`. Values within the array are combined with a logical OR.

products.description: The feedback products to include. A maximum of 100 values is accepted. Each value must contain at least one non-whitespace character, be no longer than 256 characters, and contain no control characters such as newlines or tabs. Invalid values return `InvalidInput`. Values within the array are combined with a logical OR.

platforms.description: The feedback platforms to include. A maximum of 100 values is accepted. Each value must contain at least one non-whitespace character, be no longer than 256 characters, and contain no control characters such as newlines or tabs. Invalid values return `InvalidInput`. Values within the array are combined with a logical OR.

feedbackTypes.description: The feedback types to include. A maximum of 100 values is accepted. Each value must contain at least one non-whitespace character, be no longer than 256 characters, and contain no control characters such as newlines or tabs. Invalid values return `InvalidInput`. Values within the array are combined with a logical OR.

FeedbackSortBy.description: The property used to sort feedback. Additional FeedbackSortBy types may be added over time.

values.description: Sorts by the time the feedback was submitted.

FeedbackSortOrder.description: The sort order applied to feedback results. Additional FeedbackSortOrder types may be added over time.

FeedbackPage.description: A paginated list of feedback summaries for a DataAgent.

value.description: The list of feedback summaries in the current page.

FeedbackSummary.description: A summary projection of a single feedback record. All properties are read-only. The `id` and `hasAttachments` properties are always present in successful responses; other properties can be null because the provider model permits null values.

id.description: The feedback record ID. This is an opaque provider identifier with a maximum length of 200 characters and is not a Fabric resource identifier.

comment.description: The free-text feedback comment. This can contain personal information.

app.description: The source application that submitted the feedback.

submittedDateTime.description: The time the feedback was submitted as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Fractional seconds can be included. The value is in UTC, using the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.

feedbackType.description: The provider-defined feedback type, such as `Smile` or `Frown`. This is not a closed set of values.

submitter.description: The principal that submitted the feedback. This contains personal information.

aiContext.description: The AI context associated with the feedback, including the prompt and response. This can contain sensitive content.

hasAttachments.description: Indicates whether an attachment bundle is available for the feedback record.

Feedback.description: The full projection of a single feedback record returned by the get feedback operation. All properties are read-only. The `id` and `hasAttachments` properties are always present in successful responses; other properties can be null because the provider model permits null values.

id.description: The feedback record ID. This is an opaque provider identifier with a maximum length of 200 characters and is not a Fabric resource identifier.

comment.description: The free-text feedback comment. This can contain personal information.

app.description: The source application that submitted the feedback.

submittedDateTime.description: The time the feedback was submitted as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Fractional seconds can be included. The value is in UTC, using the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.

feedbackType.description: The provider-defined feedback type, such as `Smile` or `Frown`. This is not a closed set of values.

submitter.description: The principal that submitted the feedback. This contains personal information.

aiContext.description: The AI context associated with the feedback, including the prompt, response, and optional chat history. This can contain sensitive content.

hasAttachments.description: Indicates whether an attachment bundle is available for the feedback record.

FeedbackAiContextSummary.description: The AI context summary associated with a feedback record. This object and each of its properties are optional and can contain sensitive content.

prompt.description: The prompt submitted to the AI. This can contain sensitive content.

responseMessage.description: The response message returned by the AI. This can contain sensitive content.

FeedbackAiContext.description: The AI context associated with a feedback record, including the optional chat history. This object and each of its properties are optional and can contain sensitive content.

prompt.description: The prompt submitted to the AI. This can contain sensitive content.

responseMessage.description: The response message returned by the AI. This can contain sensitive content.

chatHistory.description: The chat history associated with the feedback. This is present only in the individual feedback resource.

FeedbackChatHistoryItem.description: A single entry in a feedback chat history. Both properties are optional because the provider model permits null values.

user.description: The speaker label for the chat entry, such as `User` or `Copilot`. This is not documented as a user identity.

message.description: The chat message content. This can contain sensitive content.
